data.text: This is a great BBQ sauce recipe!!! I have been looking for a BBQ sauce recipe ever since Old Chicago stopped offering their honey chipotle sauce on BBQ wings. This sauce is much better then the OC sauce was.

This is the only way I have been making baked potatoes for over 40 years. I also sprinkle pepper over the outside and my family loves them. I started making baked potatoes this way years ago because this was how my elementary and h.s. cafeterias made them and I just loved them. Now, my family won't eat them any other way.  I also use them in making Potato Soup #40173.

I made this tonight for my husband's birthday.  OH...MY...GOODNESS....talk about yummy!!! I could only eat half of mine but hubby are all of his. We started eating before I could take a picture so I'm uploading my half-eaten serving.  I love how easy it is to make.  I served it with raspberries and vanilla frozen yogurt.  Thanks for sharing!

Absolutely one of the best recipes I have tryed for chocolate biscotti! I made three batches of these wonderful cookies for my party tray this Saturday. Made exactly as dirested didn't change a thing. I did make one batch with chopped almonds and tiny chocolate chips. These cookies were delicious and DH has already gotten in the them LOL! Thank you very much Mean Chef for another winner....Kittencal:)
I've been using this recipe forever but I kick min up a notch by ommitting the vanilla and adding kahlua. Very yummy!!!

I made this recipe about 2 1/2 years ago when I was searching for a salt free cajun seasoning and just love it.  I hate how salty commercial brands of cajun seasoning are, so this one is just great...I make the full recipe and it lasts for a while. And it takes about 3 minutes to put together! I season catfish, jambalaya, and gumbo with this and then I can control how much salt I want to use in my recipes.  This seasoning has a nice kick.  Thanks for posting this!!!

Ms Gertz, this is the only recipe I use for bread pudding.  I've made it many times and apologize for not reviewing before now.  I shop for Pannetone during the Christmas season just to make your recipe!  One Pannetonne makes 2 8-inch pans or 1 9x13 pan full.  If using the smaller pans, one goes to a neighbor or to the freezer to savor later.  The whisky sauce is a keeper too. Many thanks for posting as it is a comfort food that reminds me of my Mom.

Simple and delicious.  The baking time is actually a little longer.  I find 45 minutes at 350 to do the trick.  This can be easily adapted to use any ingredients you have on hand.  I have made it with a sausage stuffing as well as a veggie stuffing.  Just start with the ricotta, egg and parmesan cheese then add whatever you like.

Yummy! Had something similar in Alabama this summer and had to make this when we got home. Served as a dessert with BBQ and the fixings. We love pecan pie, this cobbler is easier and a nice alternative. Makes a lot and would be good to serve to a crowd. More "crust" and less custard than a pie. Oat flour is a great addition. We ate as is but would be good with a scoop of vanilla ice cream on top, too. Next time I'll bake a little less, but think that may have more to do with my oven than the recipe. Thanks for sharing!

I used leftovers to make these for a quick lunch.  We didn't have any ham.  Mine was on a sub bun- I added Italian dressing & Pizza Seasoning and broiled mine until it was crispy.  My 3 year-old DD had hers on a bagel, heated just until warmed.  Lunch was good, quick, and easy- thanks!

These were tastey made as directed.  I did add a little chopped green onion tot he top and some salt and pepper, but otherwise made as is.  I liked that you get  your veggies and a potato side done in one dish!  Made for Everyday Holiday.

We love these biscuits! I usually add a bit of oregano or Italian seasoning, for extra flavor. I also make 6 rather than 8. This allows the biscuit to be cut and for example, make bacon and egg breakfast sandwiches.

This rice is great.  It came out a little more sticky than I had hoped for but it was flavorful.  I had to cook it for an extra 10 mins but it was worth it.  I will definately make it again, but I will use only about 1 1/2 cups of water.  I used 2 small tomatoes and I think the liquid from the blended items made it too moist.
This really is better after marinating overnight.  Love this salad.
These fritters were so good!  My husband and I ate them up in a hurry.  I can't wait to make them again and soon.  Thanks for sharing a great recipe!!

This was an excellent bake. I must admit that, before making the recipe, the duo of vegetables seemed a bit odd to me, but upon tasting the finished product it is evident that the two flavors compliment each other. Succulent, warm, and healthy, this is sure to be a new family favorite. Thank you for the recipe!
I did the microwave version and used ground turkey instead of beef. Also added a bit of organic quinoa. Delicious!

My husband and I loved these cookies, but I had a small problem with them sticking to the sheet. I got the best results by using parchment paper; this also prevented them from browning too much on the bottom. 
Great recipe, I LOVE the molasses flavor.

This was great!  I couldn't use Frank's ...sorry ;), because we were stuck in a snowstorm and I had to use what I had on hand.  I used Crystal hot sauce...otherwise followed your recipe. We made this for Eagle's playoff game snacks.  My family loved it on their wings!  My husband's face was red and he had tears coming out of his eyes, but it he thought is was soooo good!  Thanks for sharing...next time I'll be sure to try it with Frank's.

I have to admit, I was a tad bit hestitant to try this one.  I've never had swordfish.  Also never had fruit (other than lemon) with fish.  Boy am I glad I tried it.  THIS WAS FANTASTIC!  A perfect pairing that we devoured!  I will certainly make this again.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for ZWT5 Groovy GastroGnomes.

I keep going back to this recipe. It is the best venison marinade I have found. My husband bought a cookbook with 900 ways to cook venison but this recipe beats any found in that cookbook. 

My boss needed a steak recipe and I gave her this one. She has asked me for it 3 times.

Couldn't be easier and packed with flavor. I went a bit too heavy on the cinnamon thinking 1/8 tsp just wasn't enough...but it probably was. And left out the cayenne as I don't like heat. Made with small red potatoes.
Yumm, made a great breakfast drink. Thanks!
These were soooo good.  I made about 60 for my annual Christmas Party and they were gone in a flash.  I should have made more, everyone loved them...
Really good flavor and not too spicy, just as we like it. I served this with crusty bread for brunch and everyone liked it very much. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

This is excellent bread! I used whole wheat flour and Yuengling Black and Tan beer, so mine came out quite a bit darker than the photos posted. Texture and flavor are great. I'm bringing a loaf to my son-in-law's beer-themed birthday party; no doubt it will go over very well.
I had to use canned green beans but tis was a tasty way to dress them up. Thanks for sharing. Made for PAC Spring 2010.

I made this over the holidays for a dinner party for 17 and adjusted the quantities accordingly.Everyone raved and two of the ladies went home with the recipe! I browned the tenderloins ahead of time and kept them refrigerated until about an hour before cooking, so they took a little longer to cook to the correct internal temperature.I used the whole berry sauce and it was delicious! Served this with M.C.'s Potaoes au Gratin with Brie and Chives and steamed green beans with a sauce of garlic butter and saute'd red bell pepper strips-YUMMY! Thanks for a great, restaurant-quality recipe, Mean!

This is another great recipe from kittencal! I absolutely love your recipe for this fish. I was looking for a lot fat/low calorie alternative to a battered fried fish. This was so easy to make, and took only a few minutes to get everything together. All the ingredients were things I already had on hand. I used tilapia fillets, and could not be more pleased with the taste and texture of this breading. The breading got cripsy which was wonderful. I am personally not a fan of fish, but was won over by this dish. Thanks to you I will be making fish much more often!
This is our new favorite whenever we make anything with a spanish flair...it is the perfect side...yummy and all of my kids love it!

When I saw these I was trying to come up with favors for a baby shower. With the theme being owls & other woodland creatures, this seemed perfect.  I got a cookie cutter of an owl, squirrel and cardinal and pressed the seed mixture into each one.  Cut up some straws and stuck them where I wanted to place the twine after they dried.  So far so good!  I love that this recipe doesn't require me to add a bunch of other ingredients, so making 20 of them doesn't cost a lot, and it's just really easy.  Thanks for this recipe!

This recipe (which I'm quite sure is Martha Stewart's), is AMAZING.  These 3 babkas are the most beautiful, delicious, and impressive items to ever come out of my kitchen.  Time-consuming and labor-intensive, yes, but well worth it.  These make wonderful gifts, if you can bear to part with them; people go crazy over the swirly slices.

I'm so sorry for this review...
The reason for 2 stars is because it was easy to perpare & it looked good,However it took more then 40 mins & was rubbery,dry & was NOT sweet,This will not be made again,Again,I'm so sorry for this review :(

Wow!!! This was such a simple meal to make but taste was like you are eating at a good restaurant.  I followed the recipe although used 3 bone-in chicken breast so increased garlic, seasoned salt mushrooms and cream.  Thanks for posting this yooper!!!!
Delicious salad.....One substitution... spinach for the greens....really a keeper

I am amazed.  The pork tasted great.  I don't have a regular oven, I have a counter-top style, which only heats to 450.  With a little adjusting of time, the pork was perfect.  Thanks for teaching me this method of cooking!

This turned out just beautifully for me.  The texture was perfect- smooth and soft with a firm crust and lovely golden color.  I used my Kitchenaid stand mixer to mix and knead, then let rise for 90 minutes and followed the rest of the directions.  I naturally had to sample a slice to be able to write a review, and I can hardly wait for dinner tonight so we can eat the rest!  Thanks for posting!

I needed to lighten the recipe a bit by using Splenda in place of the sugar, 2 tbsp of oil and 2 of applesauce and I used plain fat free yogurt. The muffins were incredibly fluffy and light as well as very moist. I used a cast iron muffin pan in fruit and veggie shapes for fun and to celebrate Fall. Mine were well baked at 20 mins. A real treat.

These are just beautiful. I cooked them over the weekend while my cousin was here. He's a big fan of food and he absolutely loved them, to the point that I sent him home with a tin. Although I did forget the coconut, they still taste yummy. It only took them about 10 minutes to cook in my oven. Next time I'm going to split the mix, put coconut in one lot and with the other half I'm going to dip half of each cookie in melted white chocolate. Thanks for a great tasting recipe. Even the kids love them!!!!

I've done enough recipe to know that not every recipes work with my bread machine. Sometimes more water or more floor is needed. In this case the dough was perfect. But I was surprised at how fast it was drying. The boiling part went very well. They also doubled in size. It took 20 min for them to be ready in the oven. Since I didn't have any eggs, I added oil to maintain the black sesame seeds on the bagels. I was surprised at how light and fluffy they are. They're very good!
These were pretty good but too strong for me - I blended then added soda water to water it down a bit.  Made for My 3 chefs
great recipe. So easy to make. oh so yummy.
What a great way to get your oatmeal. We fell in love with these, didn't have any applesauce so used syrup. Delish! Made for holiday tag. Another keeper, lorrie.

I don't like messing with mashed potatoes.  I never seem to get the timing right and they are cold at meal time.  This recipe solved that problem.  When I made it I cut it in half but found that the quantity was still too much for my family so I placed it into two loaf pans and gave one to my sister for her dinner that night.  My family LOVED this.  My sister loved it too.  I thank you KC_Cook and my hubby thanks you because I have added mashed potatoes to our meals.

Very delicious and refreshing!  I did not quite follow the recipe to a "T" as I freeze leftover coffee in ice cube trays and had plenty of ice cube coffee.  I just substituted 4 cups of ice cube coffee for the coffee and ice.  This worked beautifully and I will be using this recipe again and again.  Not nearly as pricy as that famous coffee house's drink but just as good.  My pocket and my tummy thanks you!

We call it Octopus in seaweed, I use green food coloring to resemble seaweed, and cut the hotdog in 8 strips to form tentacles, leaving enough at the top to form a 'head' boil the hot dog just long enough for the tentacles to 'curl' and dab two drops of mustard to form eyes our boys LOVE IT!

I did without the sourcream in the enchiladas.  I made it for the children also, so instead of serrano peppers i used bell pepper.  Taste like lime was in the sauce but didnt use none at all.  This sauce is best green sauce ever.  I also used adobo sauce instead of adobo seasoning in the broth.  Very tasty.  Kids couldnt get enough.

These were amazing! I made this for a large Christmas dinner. I should have tripled the recipe because they went so fast. I was concerned since I had to leave out the paprika due to someone with severe allergy. I substituted fresh mushrooms and used onion soup mix. I made again later for myself and added the paprika. Both dishes were absolutely fabulous! Thank you for sharing! It will be my Christmas dish from now on.

I really enjoyed this! I used fat free mayo, reduced fat mexican cheese & panko instead of breadcrumbs. I added some low sodium taco seasoning into the panko which added a great kick. I too baked my chicken for about 25 minutes. Since I like a little "kick" I may add some cayenne or chili sauce into my salsa (which is only medium heat) next time. It was fast & easy; thanks for sharing!

I grew up eating this dish as well. I am the only one left who eats it , so it is now a dish I only eat on Easter morning. The only thing I do differently is I keep the yolks seperate ,crumble them in a bowl ,and cover the entire top with a dry yolk mixture. Awesome readers should try this dish.

I'm visiting my oldest son and I've been cooking for him and his new wife. Tried this recipe last night and it was a huge hit with us.  I did add some cayenne pepper, garlic salt, ground black pepper and alittle greek seasoning for more of a spicy flavor.  This is a KEEPER!  Thanks for sharing the recipe! :)

This is the worst thing I've ever made in my life. What a waste of good ingredients. My husband is currently out to get some fast food for my family as we just can't eat this. I followed everything exactly. This was in the oven first for 1 hour then 2 and still the rice is hard, the middle is mushy while the edges are burned. The flavor is horrible and consistancy...well...it leaves a lot to be desired. I'm sorry, I really wanted to like this but it is horrible. Maybe I did something wrong. Maybe you should look over your directions and see if something is missing.

I can assure you there's nothing "basic" about this recipe!
I went to the market last weekend and bought some pure maple syrup, and didn't want to waste it on boxed pancake mix, so I tried this recipe...AMAZING!!! you have to try it.
So long Aunt Jemima :)

we loved this recipe but made some adjustments.
Cut the seasonings in half and bake the wings at 425 degrees for 25 minutes.
When I first made the recipe I tried the broiling but my wings seemed over cooked.

We have been drinking this lovely warming drink everyday for the last week or so with our predawn Ramadaan breakfast. I made at times with cinnamon powder, at other times with rolled cinnomon bark and cinnamon powder and again  with cinnamon powder, cinnamon bark and green cardamom. This is a realy good and versertil recipe.

Very good flavor.  I thought these would be kind of bland, but they weren't.  They didn't stick together well with just 2 eggs, so I added one more.  I think next time I will whiz everything in my food processor and see if that mixes it better.  Thanks!

I made this for supper tonight and my family ate it but they thought it needed something. If I made it again I would use salsa in place of the tomato sauce and  I'd add corn or black beans or maybe black olives. Or maybe a can of Rotel tomatoes. It wasn't bad, though, we just like our food a little more zippy.
YUM!  This is the simplest, yet most delicious, (leftover) potato pancake receipe I have found.  My kids love this one!
This was way to easy for as good as it was. By far the best wheat pizza crust I've made. Thanks for sharing, this one is absolutely a keeper.

This is a very good recipe, and a new twist to Chicken Adobo, which is a family favorite.  I used boneless, skinless thighs, and added in a hand full of chopped green onions during the last couple of minutes of cooking.  The flavor was wonderful, and I'll be making this time and time again.

This is indeed simple and very easy to make, but if you check the procedure, it doesnt say anything about adding water. I suggest that for more flavor, the ground beef, onions and garlic after being browned, be allowed to simmer for about 20 minutes before the rest of all the ingredients are added.  It turns out tastier. On the whole, it is a fast one-dish meal with lots of fiber too.
Good and garlicky with a yummy cheese flavor.  We enjoyed them

I made this for our Boss's Day Brunch at work and it was a hit! The only thing that I did differently was to add twice as many blueberries as the recipe called for and then I sprinkled a couple of tablespoons of sugar on top of it before I baked it for the last 30 minutes. I will definitely make this again!
My this was good and so different! I loved the slight sweet tart flavor added to the hummus! I halved the recipe and served with crackers and carrots. Thanks! Made for Everyday is a Holiday game.

I've made this for years and it's a HUGE FAVORITE of my Saturday morning breakfasts with my friends. I saute' Italian hot/sweet sausage, crumbled, onions and peppers, diced in butter then mix into the the cubed Italian loaf of bread. Mix mozz, romano and other misc. cheeses I want to use up into scrambled eggs/milk or heavy cream and pour over the bread mixture in a huge porcelain casserole or individual casserole dishes. Bake and devour. Lots of salt, pepper and granulated garlic goes into the eggs too. SCRUMPTIOUS

Super easy, full of flavor. It's the perfect amount of cinnamon flavor. I combined the dry ingredients, then added the wet ones & apples. They baked perfectly in 16 minutes. I think I would increase the chopped apple to a full cup, though. 3/4 cup is about half a small apple; I used Gala. Thanks - I will make these again .
My Mother always called these Missouri Cookies, though years later I learned most everyone else called them No-Bakes.  To me they will always be Missouri Cookies and the wonderful memory of my Mom.

Yes, this recipe is bland IF you do not make a few changes.  Reading some of the complaints, I made a few simple modifications and it really made this delicious.  First and foremost, to prevent a mushy steak, I cooked it for a total of 3.5 hours (high for 1.5 hours and low for 2).  The texture was perfect as I like a little chew to my meat.  Like many others I put salt, pepper and garlic powder on the steaks before dredging in flour.  To the soup/gravy mixture I added a a generous pinch of salt, couple shakes of Worcestershire, a clove of crushed garlic and a rough chopped onion.  It was delicious.

It was absolutely fantastic!  I used some red potatoes, because they were all I had but this was absolutely delicious!

I like some heat, so I added some chiracha sauce on top of the sour cream and it was soooooooooo good.

Wonderful marinade for chicken!  I left my chicken in the marinade for about 3 1/2 hours, then grilled and ended up with flavorful, moist and juicy chicken.  Light, fresh and delicious - thanks for sharing!
This recipe is the best.  People don't believe it (I didn't either) until they try it.  So simple and comes out perfect every time .
Most time consuming part was dicing the meat, but sure was worth it!  Everyone raved about it and I have already had requests for more.

I love a challenge. Actually, I made this because ofthe reviews :)  I added the buttermilk alternating it with the flour. Was very careful not to overmix it because THAT CAUSES IT TO NOT BAKE IN THE MIDDLE. I heated my oven to 350 and baked for abut 35-40 minutes (only because I personally like a darker crust). It was great! Good recipe wildflower, I'm keeping this one to make again.
Ran out of nuts so replaced these  with dried apricots. The proportions of everything are spot on and the recipe is excellent for when your kids want to help out.
Great recipe--I modified it slightly by using romaine lettuce and sauteeing the zucchini in 1/2 the oil for 3 minutes, then adding them to the lettuce.  The heat wilts the romaine a little-delicious!

This has a delicious taste. I used the Yukon Gold potaotes (also my fave type) as suggested by the recipe poster and they took far longer to soften up. Next time I think I would prefer to either parboil the potatoes chunks first or use a starchier potato like a Russet, which softens up faster.  Took 35 minutes before my potatoes were tender enough to puree. Creamy, elegant looking and worthy of company.
Potluck tag 2009: Fresh, simple - easy to make!! This salad is veggies at their best!!
The dressing was a nice way to use cranberries. Healthy and yummy too. Thanks. Made for 123 Hit Wonders game.

Very easy to make, kids loved it, 5 thumbs up.
I will be making this again

Thanks for the recipe

boy, we'll be doing this again!!! very easy and yuuummmmy. I did a 4Â½lb 
roast for the 15 min at 450Â° and one hour at 350Â°it turned out perfect and very tender....thanks for this simple and quick recipe. my DH had 4 slices and it went to fast to get a picture. delish!!!
This was so easy to make and my daughter and friends loved them!  Thanks Sarah

I used 4 partially frozen chicken breasts, and added a small sweet onion, garlic powder and black pepper.  This was so simple... and, man, the results are great!  I will definitely be making this again.  (Oh, and I cooked on low for 8 hours since the chicken was not thawed)

You're right, "this is not your average chowder" it went together quick and easy, and was rich and creamy and the spices complimented the dish nicely.  As it is soooo rich, I think next time I might add some potatoes to it and maybe even try with crab meat.  Mmmmmm, DH said this is diffently a "do again" dish.  Made for PARTY - 2010

This was a HUGE HIT at my house! My family just devoured it. Followed the recipe exactly, very easy dough with the Kitchenaid mixer, using ground beef & jalapeno sliced black olives. The crust is very nice. Crispy on the outside but still tender on the inside. Thanks for posting, rhondalynne! You have been adopted during Fall 2009 Pick A Chef! http://www.recipezaar.com/bb/viewtopic.zsp?t=310505&postdays=0&postorder=asc&start=0
Well the flavor was nice, but.... with young children I wouldn't recomend it.. the shake was VERY thin and my boys kept choking on the walnuts that past through their straw.

Thanks for posting.  I never make meatloaf, because I just can't find the right recipe. I was searching for a meatloaf recipe that used what I had on hand - no onion soup mix or other exotic flavors!! I used 1 1/2 pounds of ground beef, so I slightly increased the breadcrumbs and used about 1 1/2 eggs (my son cracked them and lost about 1/2 of the egg on the floor!)  I left out the onion and parsley - for the kids sake, and I used ketchup and soy sauce and worchestershire for flavor.  Plus I used a little Goya adobe seasoning. Very nice firm meaty (not bready) meatloaf! Thanks!
Aussie Swap#35: Loved this! I made this for Christmas morning breakfast - delicious! None were leftover!! Thanks Tarty!

Phenomonel cheesecake!  It has a light, sweet/tart taste that is quite suprising (considering how tart rhubarb can be. Don't leave out the sour cream topping; it is a must!!  I had put down 2 large freezer bags last summer; I just finished the last of it today!!  Love the recipe for the fact that it is fast and easy to make...doesn't cost $25 just for the cream cheese...I can cut the recipe in half and serve it to 6 people... and, my family demands that I made it!!  This is one recipe that I would highly recommend!!  Kudos on a great posting!!

So lively and refreshing. The dressing was delightful. I made the salad 1hr earlier as suggested and the dressing really gave depth to the tomatoes and cucumber. Thanks for a great summer salad Chef floWer
These were dee-lish!  Very Sex and the City!
this is a fave dessert in my home with family & friends. we love it! easy recipe to follow also!

Made this recipe for christmas boxes, Must have done something wrong because it didn't harden, However I simply rolled it into bite size balls and coated in powdered sugar, my recepients are still raving about them. they are excellent,

A wonderful fluffy, tasty, cinnamon cake. I made it with an egg and baked it in a 9 x 13 pan. After baking, I drizzled white glaze over the top. Yum! My family and I loved it. The next time I want a fast, breakfast treat, this will be it. Thanks again Kittencal for a great recipe.
I think this was one of the best things I've ever eaten!  Made this for Valentine's day with 2 lbs of shrimp, and it was Heavenly!  Added just a little bit extra of the parmesean.  LOVED IT!

Made for Christmas Eve 2014: Saw one of the Food Network stars making these on the Rachael Ray show. She said her grandmother always made them at Christmas time. I made some with my 3 grandkids and their dad said they were outta this world good. So easy and fast to make. We made with the chocolate almond bark and then took white almond bark and made thin lines going back and forth with some on a spoon. They were pretty. Thanks for posting this so I can easily find it when I need it!
i plan to try this because i am always looking for a good crust recipe, however, it can't be ny pizza unless you are using water from ny,

I love these!  They remind me of the ones my grandmother used to make.  Because my husband doesn't like them, I omitted the peppers.  I used apple cider vinegar.  I will try white vinegar or rice vinegar next time, just out of curiosity... but this recipe is great, as-is.

Great chops!! They weren't too spicy (probably because I accidently lost most of the seeds when I drained the peppers, lol), but had a really nice smokey flavor. Loved the hint of orange in these too. Thanks Toni for another great recipe. Made for Zaar Stars Tag.

Made for the 123 Tag Game.  These are delicious!  I followed the directions exactly, except that I didn't have self-rising flour.  That was no problem, I just added 1 1/4 teaspoon of baking powder to my all-purpose flour and it worked perfectly.  The texture of the scones are perfect... soft and tender.  I did add just a small sprinkling of fresh Parmesan cheese to each scone before baking.  I'll be serving these tonight with soup.  Thank you FlemishMinx for posting and I'm really sorry it took so long to leave a review!

This was excellent ~ very easy to fix & yummy good! I made a half recipe, subbing leek for the green onion as they are not easy to find here. Mine was done at 55 min, but I did have to tent it w/foil at 45 min because it seemed to be browning faster than the center was cooking. I think using cream would be overkill as this is rich from the cheese & has perfect texture just using milk, This dish works for a breakfast, brunch. luncheon, meatless main course & can be expanded to a 1-dish meal w/adds ~ so it gets high marks from me for versatility. In my mind, it has endless options. Thx for sharing this recipe w/us. We loved it!

Made a half recipe (which still filled a turkey roasting pan!) and diced the potatoes so that at 400 F and 50 minutes they would be done at the same time as the chicken breasts. I doubled the lemon, used fresh oregano, and used more onion rather than add the mushrooms and pepper. We loved the veggie portion of this - so lemony. Like other reviewers, I also used more and whole cloves of garlic (8 for the half recipe); it was really yummy having the roasted garlic in it. Next time I think I would skip the meat and just make the rest as a delish side dish.
Delicious! I also used only 1.5C sugar and it was great. Also added a pinch of instant espresso powder. If you're looking for homemade chocolate sauce, look no further.
I also liked this recipe.  It was great warm and the leftovers will make a great chicken salad.  Very quick weeknight dinner.

Tried these last night. I am so glad we did. It was one of those nights when nothing looked particularily good. Normally I dont like meatbals but my Hubby loooves meatball subs so I thought what the heck I'll try them. Well holy cow am I ever glad I did. I used the family basic meatball recipee and jarred pasta sauce as I was still feeling very lazy. It worked out perfectly. I put our left overs into the freezer so I am hoping they will work in future as a OAMC recipee.
So good! My husband and I both love cilantro and garlic, and he loves red potatoes, so this was a must try. So glad I did! I did broil them and they turned out great!
This was wonderful and easy to make! My mom and I LOVED it. Thank you!
Super easy and the kids loved it. I doubled the Worcestershire for a little more punch. Topped with shredded mozzarella cheese. Thanks for a nice weeknight family meal.

What a wonderful meal!  Our entire family really enjoyed the flavor of the fish and the "sauce" was so....good! I would prepare "Mexican or TexMex" style side dishes because I served the boring baked potato etc. and it didn't do the salmon any justice.  We will be making this more and sharing the recipe!  Thanks!
This is extremely easy to make and the scallops come out perfectly every time.
My husband LOVED these, they were soooo good and easy to make.

Reviewed for Aus/NZ Forum June Recipe Swap- made these tonight with my 8yo daughter. Easy to make and my family were eating the cakes before they had finished cooling! As I am gluten-free, my daughter Holly gives you 100 stars for these rainbow cupcakes. We made20 cupcakes, though our cases may have been larger than standard size. Photo to be posted. (Sorry to be so late with my review)
Great recipe, I doubled it and used one full bottle of my home canning plus one fresh peach. Both worked well and cooked in under an hour. delicious!

Simple and tasty! I used fresh peaches from the Farmers Market along with some nice juicy raspberries. My husband looked around for more after he licked his bowl clean and was so disappointed I wasn't going to share mine. LOL! This is one recipe I'll be repeating all summer.
Both DH and I loved this!  Very simple to throw together and had a great swiss cheese flavor.  I baked it for the 15 minutes and the asparagus still had some crunch to it, Perfect!!  Thanks!!

Asparagus grows wild where we live, so we eat a lot of it. Both my Dh & I agree, this is the ONLY way to cook it from now on !! Thanks for sharing. I may try straying it instead of coating with oil to lightened it up just a little, but this recipes ROCKS !The next time I prepared this I did sprinkle with parmesan cheese instead of salt and spraying with Olive oil cooking spray and like this even better

5 Stars, what a delightful meatloaf, surprisingly it was not too sweet.  This went together quickly.  I had about 14 oz of whole cranberry sauce, but I think it was enough.  My 5 mini loaves fit in a 9x11-3/4 glass casserole.  It does taste balanced, and I didn't miss the ketchup treatment.  Thanks for posting, Syd. Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.

I think this recipe would be better if it was treated more like a casserole - Saute the onion, mushrooms, and garlic (with some ginger and more vegetables, like zucchini, peppers, and napa cabbage), deglaze with soy sauce and chicken stock, and add rice. Spread into a 9x13 baking dish (no foil necessary), placing 4 chicken breasts on top afterward. Finally, finely crumble the Top Ramen noodles on top for added crunch. Toss the seasoning packet and make a mojito with the lime....just a suggestion ;)
My mom has been making this pie for many years--always a family favorite!!!
This recipe saved me this morning! Kids and husband gobbled it up. I added raspberry jam dotted throughout and it came out of the oven gooey and yummy. Thanks for posting

This chicken was very tasty, we enjoyed it, except for the mushrooms, they were ok but didn't seem cooked enough and were a little rubbery. The ingredient list did not include pepper, it was just mentioned in the instructions.  The wine, lemon, shallots and basil were a nice combination of flavours. I think the mushrooms would have been better had they been chopped into small pieces. Over all easy to make and good on the pallate. /Thanks for entering the contest and good luck.

These are quite possibly the best cookies I have ever made. My kids keep begging for more. They are easy, delicious, and beautiful. The tops are all crackled and sparkly from the sugar. I did not dip in the white chocolate, but I might on the ones that I'm freezing. They are so good. Try this recipe, you won't be disappointed!

WOW!  There's not much to say about this recipe that hasn't already been said.  This lamb is absolutely amazing.  Lots of mashed potatoes are definitely a must to slather in the delicious gravy.  I will most definitely be making this again and again.  Thanks for posting this fantastic recipe Kiwi!

I was also born and raised in a small Kansas town that had a lot of German influince. Same one as Jayhawker actually,(I wonder if we've met)! Anyway, this is how my Granny always made them except she simmered the cabbage instead of frying. She also always used a sweet roll dough. I make them alot for my family. They are so good and well worth the effort put into them!!

Yum, this salad is very enjoyable and what a great way to use cabbage. I had some regular cabbage that needed to be used up and I'm so glad I picked this delicious salad.  The toasted sesame seeds, almonds, and ramen added a nutty taste that enhanced it wonderfully.  I had a serrano chili (needed to use it up) that gave it a slight edge.  Thank you Cooks4_6 for sharing.  Made it for Photo Tag.

I added the lime zest.  I found there was too much olive oil to lime ratio, so I added more.  I couldn't make my mind up between a salad and pasta for lunch.  So I mixed spaghetti and romaine with cilantro and used this to dress it.  Yum.
This had me in and out of the kitchen in no time, and was a hit with the kids. I made a half recipe which served 4 of us. Just delicious, thank you!
This is a wonderful recipe for bbq chicken! It was super easy, too! This one will be eaten often in our home - thanks for sharing!

I made these for my parents 40th anniversary party. They were a huge hit. Everybody thought they were fantastic. I doubled the recipe and I hardly had any left to bring home. I did them the day before and heated them up at the party. They were great! I will definately be keeping these in mind when Thanksgiving rolls around. How nice to be able to have great mashed potatoes and not be taking up room on the stove or in the oven!!

This proved to be such a simple and delicious recipe (excuse the pun!!).
I know that it's a no knead recipe, but I couldn't really help myself, and I had to have a little knead, purely for self satisfaction purposes!!
The dough itself was very easy to work with,and next time I will definitely use the KitchenAid for mixing purposes and attempt not to knead it (old habits die hard!!).
The end result was a very light and delicious loaf that really didn't stand much of a chance once it emerged from the oven,as my keen-nosed children and DH moved in for the kill,armed with knives and butter!!
Thanks ElanieMay..made for PRMR.
I made this as an Entree for our Australian Seafood Christmas last year - it was absolutley delicious! Will be on the menu again this year!

I am giving this five stars due to the inspiration; although I changed several things. For the cracker mix, I added more Parmesan cheese, more garlic powder, and more dill weed than what was called for. I used Tilapia fillets instead of haddock. When prepping the fillets, I dipped them in flour prior to the egg. These changes were made after making the recipe several times. The basic recipe is very good, I just had to tweak it a little for personal taste. I made my own tartar sauce, when extra lemon juice, and I served it with salted sliced tomatoes, macaroni salad, and corn on the cob-delicious meal! Also, very easy and fairly quick; the fillets cooked four minutes on each side.
We really liked this, especially my 6 and 4 yr old boys.  It's easy and filling.  I cut it in half and baked it in an 8x8 for 40 minutes.  I'd definitely make it again.  Thanks!
Wonderful!! This is sweet, moist, tastes great! We loved the topping! This was a very easy recipe to make. I will definitely make this again! Thanks Mirj!!
This was very good! The liquid smoke really added to the taste. We will make this again for the holidays (and other times too).
I loved these. My sisters and I made these for Halloween treats at church. They came out freaky looking.

This is a very creamy sauce with a little bite.  I served it on roast beef, from the deli, sandwiches.  I think next time I might add just a little more horseradish.  My son added some blue cheese to his sand.  He loved the sauce too.  This was super simple to make with a very big reward.  Thanks MizzNezz for a very good recipe!
Another hit with the family!  I think I'll try it in my counter top rotisserie next time.
Very tasty and you will keep snacking on them!

I thought this was a very tasty drink.  I'm wondering if using regular milk was a mistake. Everyone seemed to enjoy it alot more using coconut milk.  Also mine had a brownish color to it that I don't see in anyone else's photos.  I am wondering what I did??  I thought the taste was good, maybe increase the amount of pineapple and ice next time.  I liked the hint of vanilla and brown sugar in the drink.

This tastes exactly like albondigas soup!!!  Exactly what we wanted.
Here are the changes we made due to ingredient shortage: omitted green beans and jalepeno, used roasted fresh aneheim chilies, (3 small ones), used half broth and half water, and omitted mint in meatballs- added 2 tsp chili powder to broth and 1 tsp. oregano and minced onion to meat.  It was really good.

I had a cup of diced tomatoes and 8 oz of baby Bella mushrooms in the fridge is this fit the bill.  Mine was very watery and a bit bland so I added a little white wine, a pinch of sugar, some Italian seasoning and simmered it for almost 40 minutes to dry it up a bit.  Since it was watery I chose to serve it atop some truffled polenta.  The combo of the two was four stars (the truffle flavor boosted the dish) but the sauce alone would be 3 in my book.
Turned out great but I tweaked it a little! Used milk instead of water and coconut oil and added 1tsp vanilla used a large coffee mug perfect size. Cured my sweet craving!
My husband and I loved this! Very tender, healthy, and flavorful. I added chopped garlic which really added to the flavors. Thanks!
These have such a wonderful flavor and texture!  We loved them.  Thanks for posting, DogandCatDoc!

The inside of the loaf was good and moist, but the outside crust was too crunchy for me.  Since baking this recipe, I re-read the previous reviews, and now notice a number that have 'crispy crust' and others had feared overbaking.  I baked mine for 55 minutes, but the crust is too crunchy for my taste.  I prefer a soft crust.  I'm sorry, I won't be making this again.

Absolutely AMAZING taste! This spread is fantastic. I am spending tonight preparing for a large picnic tomorrow and this recipe was on the menu. I must say, I'll be surprised if it makes it to the table tomorrow!! YUM !!
I substitued spinach for the arugula and added a bit of garlic because I love garlic!  My husband enjoyed it and even asked that I put it in my collection of frequent recipes.
Turned out great. Previously used another recipe for crust that turned out too chewy and tough.

Just finished up my first plate of these and had to stop to write a quick "thank you!".  These were very good pancakes.  I followed the recipe to the letter for the first time out, using whole wheat pastry flour.  Even my kids, who are used to mom's pancakes the egg/dairy-way said they were really good.  The only thing I would change next time is probably adding a little more milk or water to the batter to thin it up a bit so that the pancakes cook all the way through a little easier before they start to get too brown for our tastes.  Thanks for a great alternative!!!

Very tasty bread. I made this on dough cycle. Then I split the dough in half, shaped into 2 french bread shapes, covered, let rise an hour. I put slits in the dough tops and baked at 350° for 25 minutes turning pan at about 15 minutes. This is the best bread with a wonderful crispy crust. So easy and delicious.

Being of Dutch heritage, I love anything with almond paste.  I just made these bars.  I used a little less sugar in both parts, used lemon juice instead of almond flavoring, used 1/4 c. applesauce, and 1/4 c. oil.  I added a 1/4 tsp of baking soda.  30 minutes is all you need in a 10x14 glass pan.  They look yummy.  This is not diet food, but a little of this is okay.  Thanks for the recipe.  Hucky
wounderful flavor, i added a little more spice and capers.  Great, great recipe

I make fudge almost identical I use real marshmallows and real milk.Every one loves it it's great to see a recipe so similar that's been around for generations.My mom told me how and I just used a combination of ideas to make my fudge.thank you for sharing your knowledge and God Bless.
I worked at Church's. This is not Church's Chicken, not even close.

Saralaya, this is a terrific dish.  I've had roasted butternut many times before, but the maple syrup and cinnamon really sets this version miles above the rest. Even Billy gave it 4*, and he's not a veggie lover.  That in itself speaks volumes.  This was very quick to put together, and only took 25 minutes in the toaster oven.  Other than putting chopped chives (right out of the garden) on top for colour, I followed your recipe exactly.  You can bet we'll be making this one again. This was served with recipe #412903 and recipe #136060.  Honoured to make this as a "Thank You" for voting for Lawrencetown, Nova Scotia in the 2010 Kraft Hockeyville Competition.
Very delicious. I tweaked the recipe a bit and made it my own.

A good breakfast muffin -- not overly sweet!  Made mine with chocolate chips.  Next time I'll bake a few minutes less -- by the time I got them out they were golden brown all around.  I'll definitely try them again.

Although this is a little hot for myself, my father loved it.  I liked the flavors and will first try removing seeds from peppers to start with, if still too hot will try a different pepper, but it will be made over and over.  Sure was glad to use up some tomatoes and what a good recipe to use them on.

Wonderful! My grandson loves tartar sauce with fries and so I've tried several on the site. This is our favorite hands-down. My grandson doesn't usually care for capers, but he's now a convert. The only thing that I will do differently next time, is to mash the capers a little before adding. I served this with recipe #86210 for a delicious meal. Thanks for sharing Toby. Made for All You Can Cook Buffet tag.

Great brunch omelete- I cut it back to 2 eggs. Didn't want to chance flipping it so I cooked it with a lid over, the omelete puffed up and the cheese meltedand it was golden underneath
Thanks Sharon123 I'll make this one again for sure.

I just made this chorizo to bring camping with us for a pot of chili and a breakfast casserole. Never even thought of making my own, as I usually just buy it. But wow, how easy and good does it taste. I did use only 1/2 teaspoon of salt to start, and used 1/2 ground turkey and 1/2 ground pork sausage. I may never buy chorizo again!

Made this for my co-workers and recieved great reviews.  Thanks for sharing.  I followed the recipe as is, however the next time I will add more spices and make it in mimi loaf pans.  Also, i may divide into 2 loaves because it seemed like it was too much for one bread and took longer to cook.

These are a lovely, different way to serve lamb chops.  The topping is very tasty but just a bit salty for me.  Maybe it was the parmesan I used. Served with chips and salad for a quick weeknight meal.

These are the BEST cookies I've made in a long time!  I've made them several times already this holiday season and I made a variation instead of the chocolate chips, I added Heath toffee chips, they came out so yummy!  Thanks for sharing your recipe!!!!

This is soooo quick and soooo delicious! The clams I bought were "minced", but still tasty. Love the addition of the thyme, Andi. Wonderful lunch on Feb. 4th-National Soup Day! Made for Holiday tag and for Nat'l Clam Chowder Day, too.
This was awesome my picky toddlers loved it.
Excellent recipe, everyone at our party loved them, thanks!!!

WOW so yummy!  I made this from a recommendation by one of the other reviewers and it was truly wonderful.  It was made for my father in laws birthday party/New Years eve party and everyone really enjoyed it.  I had trouble finding linguine so I used fettuccini otherwise kept everything the same, I even used the optional coriander.  Thank you ~Leslie~
Use parchment paper. Leave space between cookies. They are much better the next day after refrigeration. Even better , not gooey, eaten frozen!
I have made this twice so far, and the taste is beyond amazing, but mine never seems to thicken up like the picture. Should I cook this on high instead of low, and are you supposed to stir it??
This was a delicious recipe!!  I used 2 extra large cans of black beans with the juices in place of the pinto beans and it still was amazing!!  I will definitely be making this one again and again!!
Light, refreshing and a great blend of flavors!!  Thank you Sage!!

These are HEAVENLY! I made them to take to my book club meeting tomorrow...but they may not last that long! The texture of these bars is perfect! And they are packed with delicious veggies, fruit and nuts. Thanks so much for sharing! I will make these again and again!
Delicious!  This was so easy to prepare, and smelled so good as it cooked.  I used mushroom/onion soup mix, cause I had it on hand. Very tender, good taste, whole family loved it!  Thanks!
I loved how rich it was on the inside! I under-cooked it so that it would melt in your mouth! I probably will be making these for Christmas. Great brownies, great recipe :)

Made your recipe as given, & we thoroughly enjoyed these baked beans! Although I make something kind of similar, I did like the addition of the ground beef & the celery! Served 'em warm the first time around, & one thing I do like about these is that their just as good served cold! Thanks for the great recipe! [Made & reviewed in New Kids on the Block recipe tag]

Made this for the 4th and was so excited that it turned out so well. It was bursting with blueberry flavor. I  had some really fresh, juicy berries so that helped alot. I am glad I made two cobblers because they were both gone before I could turn around. Thanks Nurse Di. You rock!!

This is super fast to put together and smells wonderful while cooking!  My bouillon cubes wouldn't really crush up, so I used powder bouillon instead.  I probably made my meatballs too large (I ended up with 13).  I think they overcooked, though, and should only be browned before adding the onion.  The additional cooking and the simmering with the tomatoes cooks them well.  I also would add some salt next time.  I know it's tricky because of the bouillon.  Made for ZWT 8.

I tried the "real" recipe #77472, at Christmas and although I thought it was very good, I wish I had this one.  It really would have impressed the in-laws more!  Or would it have made them out-laws?  Honestly I think after trying this I wouldn't have cared!  Thanks for the laugh Rita, this one was really a hoot!

I love this recipe!  I love cole slaw and broccoli salad, so this is the best of both worlds.  My extended family (20 of us) now ask for this dish specifically.  It is great for cook-outs and big parties too.  I 4X the recipe to make a party size bowl and there are rarely leftovers.  I use 2 bags of the slaw mix and about 4 crowns of fresh broccoli cut into small buds.  Since we have onion and nut allergies and a diabetic in the family, this is perfect.  Also, compared to the other broccoli slaw recipes, this one is 
MUCH lowere in fat.  Thanks for the recipe!

I am always on the lookout for new pressure cooker recipes, and this one will be in the regular rotation.  Great flavor.  I used Guinness Stout for the beer.  Would be good with lamb also!  Made for Spring 2011 PAC game.
It was ok. My kids didn't like it much, and I didn't go back for seconds. I think with some adjustments, I might like this dish. I think it needed more of the jam.

I wasn't sure about using the mushrooms raw, but this turned out really yummy! I scaled the recipe down for one person. Much enjoyed! Thanks Herb-Cat! Made for the Pick a Chef event in the contests forum.

HUGE HIT at my Halloween party last night. People just couldn't stop eating it.  They loved the name, too.  We had a food competition and it tied for 1st in Overall Best Dish, tied for 1st in Best Tasting, and tied for 1st in Most Creative Name category (I called it Creepy Dead Body Parts Dip).  I will make this again for future parties - they loved it!  Thanks!!

Yummo!  The roasted garlic really does make a difference, it's so much more mellowed and mild. I reduced the amount of butter to half a cup and even then I felt guilty about the fat content. I used  a loaf of french bread and just sliced it diagonally then slathered the slices with the garlic/butter mix and wrapped it in foil then baked for 20 minutes or so at 180C. can't wait to try it with the sourdough.

What a delicious recipe. I haven't had these since I was a kid. I roasted my jalapeno pepper which gave it more of a kick... lol maybe too  much of a kick. Was a tad spicy to me, but my hubby thought it was perfect. I used a whole bulb of garlic too since we are garlic lovers. Very good indeed and we're looking forward to eating the next round.

The photo made me hungry, and was looking for something Mexican to made.  I ran across this recipe stored in my favorites and decided to give it a try.  I am so glad I made it, cause my family gave me so many compliments on it!  I didn't tell them it was your recipe :)  This is so great with Mexican rice on the side!

So easy, and so good! I couldn't resist adding a bit of garlic salt to each piece. I used boneless, skinless breasts and they turned out very moist and delicious. My son really liked it and that is indeed a compliment as he is not much of a meat eater.  Thx PanNan
Wow so easy and so delicious.  Followed the directions exactly, made no substitutions.  My friends and family loved it.
I made this bread on the weekend and it turned out great. So tasty and light!!
This was great - love the fact that it can be made in the crockpot!  Thanks for posting.  Made and reviewed for Potluck Tag.
My family REALLY liked this one. Easy to prepare and will be making it again. Thanks!
Outstanding cookies!! I couldn't wait for them to cool an hour in the fridge. I made some anyway. They are excellent!!

Great lasagna recipe!! My family and I don't care for cottage cheese or ricotta cheese so we left that ingredient out; it didn't affect the recipe at all. As others have said, the lasagna should sit for 15-20 minutes after it comes out of the oven because otherwise it is a little runny. This recipe is definitely a keeper in our "Great Recipes" book! Thanks a lot NurseDi! :)
Great potato. So simple to make and very tasty.   I will make these again. Made for your win Football Pool 2010 week 9.

I made this for my co-workers breakfast. Everyone loved it. It was very easy to make. I baked it the night before and re-heated it in the morning. I served it with salsa and sour cream and my recipe#200730. I was a little disappointed that the cheese and tortilla kinda became combined into the egg mixture and didn't stand out. I would like to try this with diced green chilies stirred into the egg mixture and perhaps layered tortillas and extra cheese over the top. Made for Holiday Tag.

I had no idea that tofu would look, and taste, like eggs! This dish, however, tasted so similar to my "usual" migas recipe. I did use crushed tortilla chips (as I usually do, because I almost always have chips, but dont often have tortillas,mon hand), and added cheese, at the end. Thanks, for this great twist!

this is fabulous and a great way to entice kids to eat this nutritious veggie. I had tried either flour or cornmeal before but not both. This time I did both mixed and it was delish. Bergy, I think the reason yours took so long was you subbed sprays of oil for the 1/4 inch which bathes the okra in heat. In any case, it is wonderful. I plan to play with a dipping sauce. Any ideas? Thanks, Mark

I've always wanted to try biscotti but never did (because of the egg content).  These were exactly how I'd imagined them to be--and better!  My husband loved these and was overwhelmed because he ordinarily doesn't enjoy biscotti.  The whole wheat flour is a must in this recipe!
This is a keeper!  I added 3/4 c of the parm because I like mine w/ more of a kick and next time I will mince the garlic so it is evenly distributed.
